meta.name: Crystal Lake
meta.description: Single mother Pam Voorhees has been unable to shake her grief after her young, sickly son Jason tragically drowned in the town lake almost a year before. When two strangers arrive at Pam's door digging into her past, a disturbing chain of events is set into motion, leaving the townspeople of Crystal Lake wondering: just who is Pam Voorhees?

videos.title: Camp Crystal
videos.overview: Unable to accept Jason's death, Pam runs from the present, only to be met by her past.

videos.title: Part 2
videos.overview: Pam attends a seminar where she is pushed to the brink; something sinister takes revenge for Grace.

videos.title: Part III
videos.overview: The townspeople go bear hunting against Levon's orders; Pam confronts Valerie at work over Grace.

videos.title: A New Beginning
videos.overview: Willow looks for her friends; Pam returns to work at the camp alongside a group of new counselors.

videos.title: The New Blood
videos.overview: Camp Crystal Lake reopens despite the mounting death toll; Pam discovers life-changing news.

videos.title: Kill Them, Mommy
videos.overview: The counselors' drug trip takes a chilling turn; Briana receives a mysterious envelope.

videos.title: Friday…
videos.overview: In the past, a young Jason shows alarming symptoms that lead Pam to question life as she knows it.

videos.title: The Final Chapter
videos.overview: Elias arrives in Crystal Lake determined to find his family; Levon and Elias have a heated clash.
